original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Repacking idle remainders of an unchanged word (covered by the packing ceiling).
Repeating the eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: For the exact selected PR1094 local word, enumerate each coordinate 2-plane in F2^9 at every helper-helper A/B addition; propagate it by least common-frame closure while preserving exact target-level, centre-frame, target, and dirty-helper endpoints; price every induced rank climb and test the exact fixed-template ceiling.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card is broad across decoder identities. This run isolates a distinct temporal frame-schedule mechanism on the selected native word, changing frame timing while holding the scalar program, helpers, start frames, and all required interfaces fixed.
bottleneck_link: Each propagated frame changes the exact local child-rank histogram that enters the paid recursive moment and its fixed-template ceiling. A beneficial schedule could lower the charged moment without changing the scalar supplier; a boundary conflict or unchanged profile cannot.
stop_rule: Exhaust the 36 coordinate 2-planes and all 2,525 helper-helper A/B addition seed gates in the pinned word, discarding closures that alter any exact internal or terminal endpoint; stop after exact ceiling intervals are computed for every surviving distinct profile.
evidence: Exact finite search covered 90,900 plane/gate pairs: 569 no-ops, 89,737 endpoint or exact-interface conflicts, and 594 valid schedules spanning 13 rank profiles. Exact interval ceilings show the best surviving profile equals the selected baseline bracket [1690054109/10^12, 169005411/10^11]; its lower endpoint exceeds every other profile's upper endpoint, and no profile clears the task's 5% gate. The serialized best-profile word passes the pinned independent exact native audit. No new kappa or supplier admission is claimed.

open_questions.question: Can a non-coordinate 2-dimensional subspace of F2^9, injected at one helper-helper gate in the same pinned word, produce a strictly higher exact ceiling while respecting the same interfaces?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The 36 coordinate planes cover only a small subset of the Grassmannian; a different plane orientation may encounter fewer fixed-frame conflicts or induce a different rank profile.
open_questions.first_step: Compute the stabilizer of the pinned gate supports and exact interface frames, quotient the 43,435 two-dimensional subspaces of F2^9 by that action, then screen one representative per orbit before exact pricing.
open_questions.blocked_by: This cycle did not enumerate non-coordinate planes; the current finite negative result is limited to coordinate planes and single-gate injection.
